planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno with fixed wiring: HC-SR04 TRIG=D8, ECHO=D9; TM1637 CLK=D4, DIO=D5; LED=D13 (high=ON). No other pins were provided, so only these explicitly wired roles are instantiated.

TM1637 behavior: initial is set to an out-of-display-range integer (10000) to request startup blank; exact display blanking and integer-cm quantization as well as 'LED uses measured distance not displayed rounded value' are handled in the SysML model.

Ultrasonic timeout: catalog request uses timeout_us=25000 as the lower bound matching 'each wait must have 25000us timeout'; the remaining business timing (60..160ms sampling start interval, <10cm LED response by 250ms including measurement+display transfer) is modeled in SysML.

Invalid handling: ultrasonic_valid drives LED and 'blank display on invalid'; ultrasonic_distance retains previous value per invalid_policy, while the model must ensure the display is blank when valid is false.
No serial I/O requirements were provided; serial_channels is empty.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Measured distance in cm (retains previous on timeout/out-of-range).

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: True when ultrasonic reading is valid (timeout/high-stuck/out-of-range sets false; retains prior distance value).

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 display content for distance (blank until first valid measurement).

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
使用 HC-SR04 + TM1637 + LED：显示距离，小于10cm LED（D13）亮
验收约定：目标板Uno；HC-SR04 TRIG=D8、ECHO=D9，TM1637 CLK=D4、DIO=D5，LED=D13，高电平亮。距离以cm为单位，回波微秒数除58；有效范围2..400cm，显示整数厘米（量化容差1cm，前导零或空白均可）。有效距离严格小于10cm时LED亮，等于或大于10cm时灭；阈值判断使用测量距离而非显示取整值。采样开始间隔60..160ms，变化250ms内反映（包含测量等待和显示传输）。每次等待回波必须有25000us超时；无回波、卡高或越界时显示空白且LED灭，恢复后继续响应。初始显示空白且LED灭；测量值和有效性必须区分，不得将超时当成0cm。原需求未指定的传感器及显示引脚采用上述公开接线，各组相同。
